product.ta-1540.summary: The TA 1540 opened the data capture range that later included the TA 1520.
product.ta-1540.history: The 1979 trade press dates its Hanover presentation to the previous year. Triumph-Adler kept it in the range with hardware and operating system upgrades.
product.ta-1540.technical.configuration: Several stations could work with data. The trade press describes the TA 1540 and TA 1520 as an interactive multi-station family.
product.ta-1540.technical.verified: BluMach has no runnable profile for this model.
product.ta-1540.technical.limitations: Model-specific firmware and startup verification remain pending.
product.ta-1540.technical.source_1: Computerwoche · Triumph-Adler setzt weiterhin auf den Fachhändler (1979)
